import SystemE
import Book1.Prop29.Main

namespace Elements.Book1

theorem helper_1_30_step2
    (AB EF GK : Line) (a b e f g h k : Point)
    (hcross : AB.intersectsLine GK ∧ EF.intersectsLine GK ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine EF))
    (haAB : a.onLine AB) (hbAB : b.onLine AB)
    (heEF : e.onLine EF) (hfEF : f.onLine EF)
    (hgGK : g.onLine GK) (hhGK : h.onLine GK) (hkGK : k.onLine GK)
    (hgk : g ≠ k)
    (hagb : between a g b) (hehf : between e h f) (hghk : between g h k)
    (hesa : e.sameSide a GK) :
    ∠ a:g:k = ∠ g:h:f := by
  euclid_apply (extend_point GK k g) as x
  euclid_apply (proposition_29 a b e f x k g h AB EF GK)
  euclid_finish

end Elements.Book1
